OCM-SDBIOS Pack v3.8.3
======================

Author:  KdL
Update:  2026.10.02

This package allows you to easily create a working custom SDBIOS for 1chipMSX, Zemmix Neo and related machines.
Any content of this package is NOT intended for a commercial purpose and is for personal use only.
The author disclaims any liability for the misuse of the contents of this package.

ESP8266 Wi-Fi support was introduced starting with OCM-PLD v3.8 for SM-X machine.
However, the Wi-Fi BIOS can also be used starting with OCM-PLD v3.4 as it automatically detects the ESP8266 hardware.

Starting with OCM-PLD Pack v3.9.1, MSX++ is the official logo granted to the evolved firmware of 1chipMSX.
Unofficial MSX3 and MSX3+ logos have been archived for disambiguation and out of respect for Mr. Nishi's MSX3 project.

MSX is a trademark of MSX Licensing Corporation.

Enjoy!
